properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Tuesday, March 28, [1933], on stationery from Cathay Hotel, Shanghai; includes description of meeting with [William] Pawley and Frank [Francis] Love from United Air Transport, as well as an update on the negotiations and his thoughts on his work; mentions [Max] Polin and Mr. Tai.
